method: Trajectory compares the last 14 days against the 14 before it. A cluster is called close only when several independent actors repeat the same structural move. Counts are shown so a thin read stays visibly thin.

trajectory.whatFollows: What buyers are judged on is changing. Expect roadmaps and RFP language to be rewritten around it within a cycle or two.
